newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates stay high on funds shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates stay high on funds shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates traded at higher levels on Sunday amid a persistent shortage of funds and are expected to open firm on Monday, dealers said.
Onvernight funds opened at 20 percent and later touched 23 percent, a dealer at KASB & Co said.

The dealer said some banks were left short at the end of the day and approached the State (central) Bank of Pakistan to avail of its discounting facility. The rates were likely to stay firm as no inflows were expected in the next couple of days.
